notes.title: Support for multiple Keyboard layouts!
notes.content:
Hey ho, typers and shooters! Hope you guys had a great weekend!

We prepared this update over the weekend for you, Neon Ships now support multiple keyboard layouts, yay!!! Being more specific those are the supported layouts:

 QWERTY / QWERTZ
 AZERTY
 Dvorak
 Workman
 Colemak


Remember that you need to choose your layout on the pause menu! o/

With that, we hope many more players can enjoy our game :3

Also checkout our new Typing game!

notes.title: TOP25 Challenge
notes.content:
Liked Neon Ships? There'll be more
Hey guys, we're happy you are enjoying Neon Ships!!

We intend to release a lot more games fun and challenging like Neon Ships, so we're proposing this challenge so the players blessed with neon powers get our next game for free!

THE CHALLENGE
The challenge is simple, you need to be on TOP25 AND have score greater than 200 at the end of launch week (February 18th at 18h GMT).

At this date we'll take a screenshot of the leaderboard and announce the winners!

IMPORTANT - Ensure we can contact you back!
We need your email to get in touch with you with the keys later, so please, if you want to participate send us an email with a print of neon ships view on your STEAM CLIENT. Like that:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39653132/e51d6a6d89daf06796a69e68815c9e8a49243dee.png
Your nickname need to appear on the screenshot, this way we'll know is really you. :)

Send it to team@sensengames.com, telling us you want to participate, and if you win we'll contact you back!

Ohh and if you feel like it
We also would love to header your feedback! So please, if you liked the game and want to see more of this, write your thoughts on our work to us! We also have a thread in discussions for feedback, feel free to write there!

PS.: The score of the developers (hugolnx & igorlinux95) won't count on TOP25 hehe

Good luck to you all, might the neon power bless you! o/

notes.title: First Feedbacks Already Implemented
notes.content:
You guys gave us some awesome feedback so we already implemented a few of them! Here goes the list, thank you!

Improvement on Screen/Resolution Configuration: We tried to auto set the player fullscreen configuration, but it was giving a headache to some players, now you can configure the resolution you want windowed or fullscreen!
No more punctuation: Some players with "different" keyboards were having problems typing phrases with punctuation, so we removed it from them!
Controls Instructions: We added a small text explaining the controls to help you know what you have available!
Fix: Don't lose letters: If the player were typing extremely fast two letters could be typed on the same frame, that case we were ignoring one letter. Not anymore, type as fast as you can!!!


Thank you a lot for your feedback, hope you guys enjoy the news!
